title: Research Assistant in AI for prostate cancer diagnostics (hourly)
summary: Digitise prostate biopsy slides and quality-check the images, build Python pipelines for whole-slide images and MRI, and help evaluate AI models. The posting mentions possible degree projects.
requirements: Completed bachelor's in AI, data science, CS, maths, medical image analysis or similar. Python and deep learning experience expected.

title: Research engineer, AI-based ultrasound diagnostics
summary: Technical lead for an AI decision-support platform for ovarian tumour ultrasound (EU MDR Class IIb): DICOM ingestion, YOLO inference pipelines, testing, hospital installs.
requirements: Master's or equivalent experience; several years of Python, Docker, Git, Linux. DICOM/PACS/FHIR a merit.

title: Research Engineer in Clinical AI and Data Infrastructure
summary: Build datasets, pipelines and tools for intensive-care research and clinical AI evaluation (time series, text, ECG, radiology data).
requirements: Relevant degree; Python/R/SQL; healthcare data experience; Swedish and English.

title: Research Assistant: prediction modelling in cognitive disorders
summary: Develop and validate prediction models and diagnostic algorithms for cognitive impairment using cohorts, registries and clinical studies.
requirements: Master's in a quantitative field plus research experience; R and Python.

title: Doctoral student in Neuronics
unit: School of Engineering Sciences in Chemistry, Biotechnology and Health
summary: AI plus finite element human body models for vehicle safety, including accident reconstruction from images and video. With Autoliv, funded by Vinnova.
requirements: Master's (or 240 credits incl. 60 advanced); mechanics/FEM; Python or Matlab; AI experience a merit.
contact: Supervisors: Xiaogai Li, Svein Kleiven, Shiyang Meng

title: Research Engineer in Robotics, Perception and Learning
summary: Build robot prototypes, collect data, analyse results and report findings through hands-on experiments.
requirements: See posting.

title: Research engineer in Python development and visualization
unit: School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, KTH
summary: Develop ImpactTwin, an interactive digital-twin dashboard for climate resilience: Python implementation, geospatial data integration and interactive maps and charts for comparing scenarios.
requirements: Master's in computer science, data science, engineering or similar; strong Python, data processing and visualisation skills.

title: Research Engineer in Soft and Wearable Robotics
unit: Robot Design Lab, Mechatronics, KTH ITM
summary: Design, build and test soft exoskeletons and their mechatronic systems for the REMA project on mobility for older adults, including experiments and student supervision.
requirements: MSc in robotics, mechatronics, electrical or mechanical engineering; CAD, 3D printing, MATLAB or Python, motor control.

title: Research Assistant for Pharmacoepidemiological Applications
summary: Support model development and large-scale processing of registry and health data from Taiwan, Sweden and other Nordic countries, including paediatric pharmacoepidemiology methods.
requirements: Linux, SAS/R/Python, Git, good English, basic pharmacoepidemiology and experience with Taiwanese registry data.

title: Research assistant in liquid biopsy development
summary: Develop bioinformatic methods for extracellular vesicles from body fluids, combining biofluid handling, lab work and RNA-sequencing analysis.
requirements: Undergraduate degree in biology or basic medical training; molecular biology lab and RNA-seq analysis experience.

title: Research Assistant in Neurodivergent Women's Reproductive Health
unit: Women's Mental Health Epidemiology group, KI
summary: Lead a register-based project on reproductive health in women with autism and/or ADHD, from literature review to publication.
requirements: Master's in a relevant field; R or SAS; regression modelling; good English.

title: Research Assistant in Cancer Epidemiology (hourly)
unit: Clinical Epidemiology, Department of Medicine Solna, KI
summary: Support data collection and register data management in a registry-based lymphoma research project.
requirements: Basic medical knowledge of cancer (especially lymphoma); register data handling in Excel or Access; R a merit; Swedish working language.

title: Research Assistant in Nutrition and Reproductive and Perinatal Epidemiology (hourly)
unit: Clinical Epidemiology, Department of Medicine Solna, KI
summary: Support research in nutrition, pregnancy and women's health through literature reviews, data management and administration, possibly also clinical studies such as PEPP.
requirements: Master's in nutrition or a related field; good English and literature search skills.

title: Research assistant (2 months)
summary: Support projects in liver metabolism, diabetes and hypoxia signalling: cell and spheroid culture, RNA/qPCR, Western blot, ELISA and immunohistochemistry with confocal microscopy.
requirements: Master's in biology, molecular biology or similar with hands-on experience of these techniques.

title: Research Assistant, Department of Psychology (hourly)
summary: Take part in a clinical project evaluating digital behavioural interventions for people with chronic pain, mainly by running telephone interviews with study participants.
requirements: Knowledge of psychological factors in chronic pain and CBT/ACT; fluent Swedish and English.

title: Research assistant focusing on genome engineering
summary: Apply genome engineering such as CRISPR prime editing, CRISPRi/a and Cut&Tag profiling in cell lines and iPSC-derived brain cells.
requirements: MSc in experimental medicine, chemistry or biology; PCR, cloning, transfection and cell culture experience.

title: Research assistant in human tumour immunology
summary: Support research on human gut and gut tumour tissue: dissection, biobanking, lymphocyte isolation, flow cytometry and single-cell RNA-seq analysis.
requirements: Master's in biomedicine, medicine or immunology by start; human tissue processing and immune cell culture experience.

title: Research Assistant in Translational Melanoma Research
summary: Support research on extracellular vesicles and circulating biomarkers of treatment response in melanoma, using cell models and clinical plasma samples.
requirements: Degree in molecular biology, biomedicine, biotechnology or similar; cell culture, Western blot and immunoprecipitation experience.

title: Research assistant, Department of Global Public Health
unit: IMPAQT group, Global Public Health, KI
summary: Prepare research grant applications through literature reviews and drafting on health systems, vaccination and maternal and perinatal health.

title: Research group assistant (50%)
summary: Practical and administrative support for a research group: ordering lab supplies, onboarding new members, booking travel, managing the electronic lab notebook and taking minutes.
requirements: Good English; administrative or lab experience and Microsoft Office are merits, as is Swedish.

title: Clinical assistant: development of cell-based therapies
unit: Biomolecular and Cellular Medicine, Laboratory Medicine, KI
summary: Develop and optimise CAR T-cell products made with viral and CRISPR-based knock-in methods, aiming for a clinical trial. Mainly hands-on lab work.
requirements: Medical or dental degree, or admission to doctoral studies in medicine; lentivirus, T/NK-cell culture, gene editing and flow cytometry experience.

title: Student assistants at Karolinska Institutet University Library
summary: Help library users with lending and services on site, plus shelving and circulation work.
requirements: Admitted to a bachelor's programme in library and information science; customer service experience is a merit.

unit: House of Governance and Public Policy (GaPP), Stockholm School of Economics

requirements: Aimed at motivated early-career researchers; no fixed list.

title: PhD student in Psychology

requirements: Second-cycle degree (or 240 credits incl. 60 advanced); at least 90 credits in psychology or a relevant subject.

title: PhD student in Ecology and Evolution
unit: Ecology, Environment and Plant Sciences (DEEP), SU
summary: Study the evolutionary drivers and genomic consequences of pollen evolution when flowering plants change pollination mode, using comparative and population genomics and transcriptomics.
requirements: Second-cycle degree with 15 credits in ecology or evolution and a 30-credit project in the area.

title: PhD student in Wetland ecology
unit: Ecology, Environment and Plant Sciences (DEEP), SU
summary: Part of the Formas-funded BALANCE wetlands project: how wetland restoration affects insect and spider abundance and diversity, and mechanisms such as oxygen deficiency in wet soil.
requirements: Second-cycle degree with ecology/evolution credits and a 30-credit degree project; driving licence and fieldwork ability.

title: PhD student in English, Literary Studies

title: PhD student in mathematics education (statistical literacy)

title: PhD student in Science Education
unit: Science Education, Department of Teaching and Learning, SU
summary: Doctoral project in science education, from compulsory and upper secondary school to higher education, preschool or informal learning settings.
requirements: Second-cycle degree plus specific requirements in science education; Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or English.

unit: Department of Public Health Sciences, SU
summary: Commercial determinants of health for addictive products such as alcohol, nicotine and gambling, including industry lobbying, regulation and marketing, mainly with qualitative methods.
requirements: Second-cycle degree, good English and at least 7.5 advanced credits in research methods.

title: PhD student in Public Health Sciences
unit: Department of Public Health Sciences, SU
summary: Part of the project Women's health and ageing: burden, determinants and consequences of conditions linked to ageing of the female reproductive system, using register, survey and cohort data.
requirements: Second-cycle degree, good English and at least 7.5 advanced credits in research methods.

title: PhD student in linguistics, child language development

requirements: Second-cycle degree incl. 30 advanced credits in linguistics and a 15-credit degree project.

title: PhD student in linguistics, sign language
summary: Doctoral project in linguistics focused on signed languages, with your own research plan on a sign language topic.
requirements: Second-cycle degree incl. 30 advanced credits in linguistics and a 15-credit degree project; English, Swedish or Swedish Sign Language.

title: PhD student in Computer and Systems Sciences, Cybersecurity
summary: Methods, architectures and evaluation frameworks for securing AI-enabled, IoT, cloud and next-generation networked systems.
requirements: Second-cycle degree with 60 advanced credits in computer and systems sciences and a 15-credit thesis; English B2.

summary: Resource-efficient multimodal machine learning for IoT, combining sensor, image, audio and text data on constrained devices, including model compression and bias mitigation.
requirements: Second-cycle degree with 60 advanced credits in computer and systems sciences and a 15-credit project; English B2.

requirements: Second-cycle degree with 60 advanced credits in computer and systems sciences and a 15-credit project; English B2.

summary: Experimental cell biology in a lab that combines wet-lab work with automated platforms and AI-driven analysis: cell culture, perturbation studies and microscopy.
